mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS occupiedSlots, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'pending'), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'accepted'), 0) AS acceptedCount FROM partner WHERE partner_id = #{mentorId} AND match_mode = 'lead' AND status IN ('pending', 'accepted') AND id != #{excludeRequestId}
